boxes.title: Control Spells
boxes.text: The control spells are: Control Animal, Control Construct, Control Demon, Control Undead, and Mind Control. If a control spell is successfully cast on a figure that is already under the effects of an active control spell, the existing control spell is immediately cancelled. Thus, a figure may never be under the effects of multiple control spells. If a figure is a temporary member of a warband and has a control spell cast on it, all links to its temporary warband are broken. If this control spell is subsequently cancelled, the figure becomes an uncontrolled creature. If a figure is a permanent member of a warband and has a control spell cast on it, it remains linked to its original warband. If this control spell is subsequently resisted or cancelled, the figure reverts to its original warband. Note that, in this way, it is possible to use a control spell on a member of your own warband that is under the effects of an opponent’s control spell. If successfully cast, this new control spell cancels the effects of the existing one and is then itself cancelled because it has no further effect. A figure under control will never use a one-use magic item, such as a potion, but will use magic items that are always on. Captains that have been controlled will never use Tricks of the Trade. Spellcasters are normally immune to control spells, but in the event that one is controlled, he will never cast spells while under the spell. A figure may not cast a control spell while it currently has a control spell of that type already active unless a specific rule allows it (such as a flourish).

flourishes.text: The caster may select any point directly under a section of terrain. All figures within 1” of that point suffer a +3 shooting attack from directly above. This flourish can be combined with collapsing a floor (the caster needing line of sight to just the floor that is to be collapsed). In this case, the point selected must be that directly under the section of floor being collapsed.

flourishes.text: If playing a scenario with limited exit points on the table, the spell can target any point on the table edge that was used as a player starting warband edge (or anywhere within 8” of a starting corner or doorway if those were used instead). criticals.failure: The caster successfully casts the spell on himself.

flourishes.text: If the spell is cast on either a wizard or apprentice, a maximum of one soldier may also activate in the phase with him.

flourishes.text: Any time a figure suffering the effects of this curse rolls a natural ‘20’ it must immediately reroll the die and accept the second result.

criticals.failure: The spell destroys one randomly determined non- magical weapon carried by the caster. If the caster has no weapons that can be destroyed, he suffers -2 on all Casting Rolls for this spell for the rest of the game.

criticals.success: The spell destroys all the target’s weapons and its shield if it has one (subtract -1 Armour for the loss of the shield).
criticals.failure: The spell destroys one randomly determined weapon carried by the caster. If the caster has no weapons that can be destroyed, then he suffers -2 on all Casting Rolls for this spell for the rest of the game.

flourishes.text: Instead of targeting one creature, the spell targets all undead within 6” and line of sight of the caster.

criticals.success: Every attack generated by the spell does an additional +2 damage.
criticals.failure: The caster suffers a +5 attack.

flourishes.name: Null Zone

criticals.success: This casting does not count against the spellcaster’s limit of having one Draining Word active, though multiple castings of Draining Word against the same spell are not cumulative.
criticals.failure: Randomly select one spell known by the caster; the caster is at -3 to cast this spell for the rest of game (or between this game and the next for Out of Game spells).

In a situation where a spell would be affected by multiple Draining Word spells, use the worst penalty to that spell, but the penalties do not stack.

boxes.title: Control Spells
boxes.text: The control spells are: Control Animal, Control Construct, Control Demon, Control Undead, and Mind Control. If a control spell is successfully cast on a figure that is already under the effects of an active control spell, the existing control spell is immediately cancelled. Thus, a figure may never be under the effects of multiple control spells. If a figure is a temporary member of a warband and has a control spell cast on it, all links to its temporary warband are broken. If this control spell is subsequently cancelled, the figure becomes an uncontrolled creature. If a figure is a permanent member of a warband and has a control spell cast on it, it remains linked to its original warband. If this control spell is subsequently resisted or cancelled, the figure reverts to its original warband. Note that, in this way, it is possible to use a control spell on a member of your own warband that is under the effects of an opponent’s control spell. If successfully cast, this new control spell cancels the effects of the existing one and is then itself cancelled because it has no further effect. A figure under control will never use a one-use magic item, such as a potion, but will use magic items that are always on. Captains that have been controlled will never use Tricks of the Trade. Spellcasters are normally immune to control spells, but in the event that one is controlled, he will never cast spells while under the spell. A figure may not cast a control spell while it currently has a control spell of that type already active unless a specific rule allows it (such as a flourish).

flourishes.name: Potent Venom
flourishes.text: The target also suffers -1 to all rolls for as long as it is poisoned.

criticals.success: In addition to the normal results of this spell, roll once on the Minor Demonic Attribute Table (Forgotten Pacts, page 14) and apply this to the target figure as well.
criticals.failure: The spell is successfully cast, but the demon manages to take control of the target figure. For the rest of the game, this figure counts as an uncontrolled creature. In addition, roll once on the Minor Demonic Attribute Table and apply this to the target figure as well.

flourishes.name: Enlarge
flourishes.text: The spell gives the target +2 damage in melee combat and the Large trait.

flourishes.name: Horned
flourishes.text: The spell also gives the target the Horns trait.

flourishes.name: Winged
flourishes.text: The spell also gives the target the Flying trait.

criticals.success: The effects of this spell only apply to spellcasters of the casting player’s choosing. In addition, this spellcaster can cast a second Power Word spell, if he so chooses, but must choose a different spell or school for it to affect.
criticals.failure: The figure manages to cast Draining Word instead, affecting the same spell or school that Power Word would have. This spell lasts until the end of the game unless it is dispelled.

criticals.success: The effects of this spell only apply to spellcasters of the casting player’s choosing. In addition, this spellcaster can cast a second Power Word, if he so chooses, but must choose a different spell for it to affect.
criticals.failure: The figure manages to cast Draining Word instead, affecting the same spell that Power Word would have. This spell lasts until the end of the game, unless it is otherwise cancelled.

flourishes.name: Encompass
flourishes.text: The spellcaster can choose for the spell to affect all the spells from a specific school of magic, instead of a single spell. All Casting Rolls to cast a spell from that school are at +1 for the rest of the game. In a situation where a spell would be affected by multiple Power Word spells, use the largest bonus to that spell, but the bonuses do not stack.

flourishes.name: Targeted Area
flourishes.text: The effects of the spell only apply to one half of the table, chosen by the caster. The table can only be split in half by straight lines running between the centre points of opposite table edges or diagonally opposite corners.

criticals.success: If the target of the spell was an enemy, the target also suffers damage equal to half the number of inches it was pushed, rounded down. If the target of the spell was a friendly figure, the caster can choose to modify the length of the push by +/-3” (this can be used in conjunction with the Pulled Punch flourish to decrease the distance up to 6”).
criticals.failure: Roll a die. The caster manages to push himself that many inches directly away from the target of the spell as though he himself were the target of a Push spell.

criticals.success: If the target of the spell was an enemy, the target also suffers damage equal to half the number of inches it was pushed. If the target of the spell was a friendly figure, the caster can choose to modify the length of the push by +/- 3".
criticals.failure: Roll a die. The caster manages to push himself that many inches directly away from the target of the spell as though he himself were the target of a Push spell.

flourishes.name: Pulled Punch
flourishes.text: The spellcaster can choose to decrease the distance pushed by up to 3” after the roll is made.

flourishes.name: Wide Beam
flourishes.text: The spell attack is also rolled against all figures in combat or within 0.5” of the target figure.

criticals.success: The caster may add one ghoul (see Frostgrave rulebook, page 191) to his warband instead of a zombie. (Though it still counts against the maximum of one zombie allowed by the spell).
criticals.failure: If cast Out of Game, the spell fails, and the caster may not cast this spell during the coming game. If cast in game, the spell creates an uncontrolled zombie. One random opponent may place this figure anywhere within 3” of the caster, but at least 1” away.

criticals.success: The caster may add one ghoul to his warband instead of a zombie.
criticals.failure: If cast Out of Game, the spell fails, and the caster may not cast this spell during the coming game. If cast in game, the spell creates an uncontrolled zombie. One random opponent may place this figure anywhere within 3" of the caster, but at least 1" away.

flourishes.name: Growing Hordes
flourishes.text: This flourish allows the warband to have a second zombie, from the Raise Zombie spell, active on the table.

flourishes.name: Rusting Weapons
flourishes.text: The zombie is carrying old, rusty weapons and does +1 damage in melee.

criticals.success: The player may make three rolls for one treasure token and choose which one to take.
criticals.failure: The spellcaster sees some vision of horror and suffers -1 Will for the coming game.

flourishes.name: All that Glitters
flourishes.text: The affected treasure token also comes with d20 extra gc.

flourishes.name: Book Hunter
flourishes.text: Instead of making two rolls on the Treasure Table, the player may roll for two different grimoires and then select which one to take.

criticals.success: The spellcaster makes a +1 magic elemental shooting attack against every enemy figure within 12”; additionally, any figure that suffers damage from this attack is moved 2” directly away from the caster.
criticals.failure: Every member of the caster’s warband within 12” and line of sight, including the caster, immediately suffers a +0 magic elemental shooting attack.

criticals.success: The spellcaster makes a +1 elemental magic shooting attack against every enemy figure within 12", additionally, any figure that suffers damage from this attack is moved 2" directly away from the caster.
criticals.failure: Every member of the caster's warband within 12", including the caster himself, immediately suffers a +0 elemental magic shooting attack.

flourishes.name: Extended Reach
flourishes.text: Increase the range of the attacks to 14”.

flourishes.name: Supercharge
flourishes.text: Each attack does +1 damage.

criticals.success: In addition to the normal effects of the spell, the target also receives +2 Fight when rolling against shooting attacks for the rest of the game. This does stack with the Shield of Scattering flourish.
criticals.failure: The caster may not cast this spell for the rest of the game.

criticals.success: In addition to the normal effects of the spell, the target also receives +2 Fight when rolling against shooting attacks for the rest of the game.
criticals.failure: The caster may not cast this spell for the rest of the game.

flourishes.name: Extreme Protection
flourishes.text: If cast upon a target that already has the Shield spell in effect, the bonus does stack, though the maximum armour rule still applies.

flourishes.name: Shield of Scattering
flourishes.text: The target also receives +2 Fight when rolling against shooting attacks.

flourishes.name: Split Cast
flourishes.text: This counts as two spells, targeting two different targets. Each gains +1 Armour.

criticals.success: In addition to the normal effects of the spell, the target also suffers -2 Move.
criticals.failure: The spell is successfully cast upon the caster.

flourishes.name: Deaden Reflexes
flourishes.text: The target also suffers -1 Fight.

flourishes.name: Stiff Fingers
flourishes.text: The target also suffers -1 Shoot.

criticals.success: This spell cancels the effect of up to two spells currently in play, and the caster takes no damage.
criticals.failure: The spell cancels the effects of all the caster’s own spells that are currently in play. In addition, the caster takes 2 points of damage.

flourishes.name: Fangs
flourishes.text: If the cancelled spell was cast upon a specific figure, that figure suffers 1 point of damage.

flourishes.name: Feast
flourishes.text: If the spell cancelled was from the school of Necromancy, the caster gains 1 point of power that can be applied to Casting Rolls or Will Rolls. A spellcaster may have no more than 4 points of power stored at one time. These are lost at the end of the game.

notes: Despite the slight difference in wording, Dispell and Spell Eater work exactly the same in their base rules (except Spell Eater hurts the caster).

criticals.success: The caster also gains +1 Fight for the rest of the game, while the target suffers -1 Fight for the rest of the game. Each bonus and penalty can only be gained once from this spell.
criticals.failure: The caster takes 1 point of damage, while the target regains 1 lost point of Health.

criticals.success: In addition to the normal effects of the spell, the caster gains +1 Fight for the rest of the game, while the target suffers -1 Fight for the rest of the game.
criticals.failure: The caster loses one point of Health (in addition to whatever is normally lost for the Casting Roll), while the target regains one lost point of Health.

flourishes.name: Every Last Drop
flourishes.text: Increase the amount of Health loss and Health gain to 4.

flourishes.name: Lifepower
flourishes.text: Instead regaining 3 Health, the caster can choose to gain 2 points of power that can be used later in the game to empower Casting Rolls or Will Rolls. A spellcaster may only have 4 points of power stored at one time. These are lost at the end of the game.

criticals.success: In addition to the normal effects of this spell, the target also gains a +1 damage modifier in melee combat for the rest of the game.
criticals.failure: The target suffers -1 Fight for the rest of the game.

flourishes.name: Arms of the Giant
flourishes.text: The target of the spell automatically passes the next Fight stat roll (a Fight Roll with a Target Number) that it is called upon to make.

flourishes.name: Beast of Burden
flourishes.text: The target suffers -1 Move, instead of the normal half move, when carrying a treasure token.

criticals.success: The caster takes no damage for casting this spell. If this spell takes the target to 0 Health, and the target is a spellcaster or captain, he must roll for a permanent injury on top of any other results for his roll on the Survival Table.
criticals.failure: The spell is successfully cast against the caster. (So, the caster immediately suffers 1 point of damage for casting the spell, and then must make a Will Roll against the spell with a Casting Roll of 14).

flourishes.name: Down and Up
flourishes.text: If the target of the spell is reduced to 0 Health, replace the target with a zombie (see Frostgave rulebook, page 193) under the control of the caster. This zombie counts as a temporary member of the warband and under the effects of a Control Undead spell. It does not affect how many other undead may be controlled by the caster from any other spell.

flourishes.name: Extended Reach
flourishes.text: Increase the range of the spell to 10”.

criticals.success: The spellcaster may move the target up to 8” in any direction provided it doesn’t lead to damage, or up to 3” in any direction, but this can lead to damage (such as falling).
criticals.failure: The spell is cast on the nearest member of the caster’s warband that is carrying a treasure token. A random opponent decides how to move this figure. If no figures in the caster’s warband are carrying treasure, the caster suffers -1 Will for the rest of the game instead.

flourishes.name: Pass the Loot
flourishes.text: If the target fails its Will Roll, instead of dropping the treasure token, the caster can choose for it to be passed to a member of its own warband that is within 2”, provided that figure is not in combat or already carrying loot. This figure is now carrying the treasure token.

flourishes.name: Suicide Charge
flourishes.text: The caster can move the target into combat and have it make an immediate attack, but not against a member of the target’s own warband.

criticals.success: The spell generates a major demon. Roll once on the Major Demonic Attributes Table (Forgotten Pacts, page 18).
criticals.failure: Place a demon on the table in combat with the caster. To determine the type of demon, roll a die: 1–10 imp; 11–17 minor demon; 18+ major demon.

flourishes.name: Demonic Ambush
flourishes.text: The demon can be placed directly into combat.

flourishes.name: Gateway
flourishes.text: The spell becomes line of sight within a range of 6”.

notes: See the Advanced Summoning Rules in Frostgrave: Forgotten Pacts for expanded use of this spell.

criticals.success: The caster may move the treasure token up to 10”. If it is moved into contact with a member of the caster’s warband, it may pick up the treasure token as a free action.
criticals.failure: Move the treasure token 6” directly away from the caster.

criticals.success: The caster may move the treasure up to 10". If it is moved into contact with a member of the caster’s warband, it may pick up the treasure as a free action.
criticals.failure: One random opponent may move the treasure token up to 6" in any direction.

flourishes.name: Beyond Sight
flourishes.text: So long as the treasure token begins and ends its movement in line of sight of the caster, it can pass out of it during the movement.

flourishes.name: Far Reach
flourishes.text: The spell can target a treasure token up to 20” away but can only move it 4”.

criticals.success: After teleporting, the caster may take one more action this activation. This can be any action the figure is normally able to perform, including casting a spell.
criticals.failure: Roll a die. Move the caster that many inches in a random direction.

flourishes.name: Homing Beacon
flourishes.text: The spell may be used to move off the table, but any treasure tokens carried by the caster are dropped before the teleport takes place.

flourishes.name: Roll Out
flourishes.text: If the caster would have had an action left after casting the spell, he may make one Move action, but at -3 Move.

criticals.success: The caster may still take his second action for the turn as normal.
criticals.failure: The caster receives a maximum of one action in his next activation.

flourishes.name: Rapid Response
flourishes.text: The caster may use the stored action at the end of a turn, after all other figures have activated. This one action can be any the caster is normally allowed to take. If more than one figure has this spell and flourish active, they must decide in priority order whether or not to use it at the end of the turn.

flourishes.name: Quick Step
flourishes.text: After casting the spell, the spellcaster can make one Move action at -3 Move.

criticals.success: Casting this spell does not count as one of the figure’s actions during this activation.
criticals.failure: Remove the caster from the table but mark the spot. At the end of every turn, roll a die. On a 6+ he returns to the table at the exact spot he left it.

flourishes.name: Time Rider
flourishes.text: If the wizard cast this spell on consecutive turns, he only suffers 4 points of damage.

flourishes.name: Novice Caster
flourishes.text: The apprentice may cast this spell. He receives an additional action in the Soldier Phase and right at the end of the Creature Phase, after all other figures in that phase have activated.

criticals.success: The caster may change the targets of this spell. Target figures receive no Will Rolls to resist this spell.
criticals.failure: The caster switches places with a random member of his own warband.

flourishes.name: Extended Reach
flourishes.text: The two target figures must be within 16” of one another.

flourishes.name: Glorious Triangle
flourishes.text: The spell can target three figures, all of which switch places with one of the other two, at the caster’s discretion. Each figure must be within 12” of both the other figures and within line of sight of the caster. Will Rolls are still made as normal.

criticals.success: The range for all parts of this spell are increased to 12”.
criticals.failure: The caster cannot cast this spell for the remainder of the game.

flourishes.name: Banish Beauty
flourishes.text: Instead of the normal rules for this spell, this spell may target a figure in line of sight of the caster with the Beauty spell active. The caster does not have to make a Will Roll. The Beauty spell is immediately cancelled.

flourishes.name: Destroy Illusion
flourishes.text: Instead of the normal rules for this spell, this spell may target an illusionary soldier in line of sight of the caster. The illusionary soldier is immediately removed from the table.

flourishes.name: Grant Vision
flourishes.text: Instead of the normal rules for this spell, it becomes Line of Sight with a range of 16”. The target gains the True Sight trait.

criticals.success: The spell generates a wall of fire. In addition to the normal effects of this spell, any figure that moves into contact with the wall, or activates while in contact, suffers 2 points of elemental magic damage.
criticals.failure: Any walls the caster currently has on the table are immediately removed. The caster may not cast this spell again for the rest of the game.

flourishes.name: Enduring
flourishes.text: The wall only vanishes on a roll of 1–2.

flourishes.name: Spiked
flourishes.text: Any figure that falls onto the wall or is moved into the wall by an external force, such as getting pushed back in combat or moved by a spell or scenario effect, immediately suffers 2 points of damage.

notes: Walls must be cast vertical to the ground and the bottom of the wall must be on the ground or on terrain. If any part of the wall is in the air, it crashes to the ground and the wall is cancelled. Walls must be exactly 6” long and 3” high but can be angled any way the caster wants to plug gaps. Walls have no appreciable thickness. Walls can be climbed as normal.

criticals.success: The wizard eye may be placed on top of a piece of terrain (but not on the ground) and gains a 360-degree field of vision.
criticals.failure: The caster may not cast this spell for the rest of the game.

criticals.success: The wizard eye may be placed on top of a piece of terrain and gains a 360-degree field of vision.
criticals.failure: The caster may not cast this spell for the rest of the game.

flourishes.name: Clinging Eye
flourishes.text: The spell may be cast on any vertical terrain; it doesn’t have to be flat.

flourishes.name: Crawling Eye
flourishes.text: Whenever the wizard activates, before taking any actions he may move his wizard eye 3” in any direction, so long as the eye stays on a vertical side of the same terrain.

flourishes.name: Second Sight
flourishes.text: The spellcaster may cast this spell even if he has an active wizard eye. If successful he may place a second wizard eye on the table and maintain both. Two is the absolute maximum though.

notes: This spell can only be cast on a flat side of vertical terrain (not the top) and cannot be cast on the ground. When the spellcaster casts the spell, the caster may use the eye as the origin point for any Line of Sight or Touch spell. It cannot be used for Area Effect spells.

description.text: This spell may be cast on any vertical terrain feature within 12” that has a flat side, such as most ruins. Place a token on or next to the terrain feature to represent the wizard eye. For the rest of the game, the caster may choose to draw line of sight from the wizard eye instead of from the figure when casting spells. The wizard eye has a 180-degree field of vision. A spellcaster may only maintain one wizard eye at a time. If the terrain piece on which the wizard eye is placed is damaged or destroyed (such as by a Crumble spell), the spell is cancelled. The spellcaster may cancel this spell at the end of any turn.

criticals.success: When this scroll is used, the spell is cast as though a critical success has been rolled.
criticals.failure: The caster starts a fire in his scriptorium. Choose one scroll currently in the wizard’s vault. This scroll is destroyed. If the wizard has no other scrolls, there is no effect.

flourishes.name: Expert Penmanship
flourishes.text: When cast, the spell is treated as having a Casting Roll of 15 (instead of the 14 that is normal for scrolls).

flourishes.name: Light as a Feather
flourishes.text: This scroll can be carried with another scroll, with both scrolls only taking up one item slot.

notes: Lichdom may never be cast from a scroll (see Frostgrave: Thaw of the Lich Lord).
